_comment: Template answers for daily check-in form. Copy this file to form-answers.json and customize for your course. Key = visible label or input name. Values can be: a plain string, an array of strings (rotates by day-of-month), or an object with 'weekday' and 'weekend' arrays (randomly picked by day type).
